nodes.description: Review recommendation to create unified ExecutionPlan dataclass merging the two parallel draft paths: _operator_pending_confirm_plan (atomic actions, VoiceNlpPlan dataclass) and _operator_pending_flow_draft (flow drafts, free dict).
